title: P2P room (real-time co-op)
description: Real-time co-op for browser games with no server: an encrypted WebRTC room over public relays (inject the trystero-027 part), joined by a share link. Encodes Escape from Slopov II's split ownership: each peer streams its own pose, the host streams the world, peers ask the host to change it. channel(name, { from: 'host' | 'any', validate, limitHz }) drops messages from the wrong sender, malformed ones and floods; approach() and approachAngle() ease received values framerate-independently; every(hz) paces sends from the frame loop; shareLink(WAREHOUSE_URL, code) makes a link that reopens the game in the room. Tested in vitest with an in-memory transport and in two real browsers over WebRTC. No host migration: when the host leaves, onHostLeft fires.
author: the internet slop warehouse

made.tool: Claude Code; extracted from Escape from Slopov II

exports.name: connect
exports.signature: connect(transport, { app, host, code, maxUsers, relayConfig }) → Promise<{ id, hostId, isHost, code, peers, channel(name, opts), onJoin(cb), onLeave(cb), onHostLeft(cb), leave() }>
exports.does: opens (host) or joins (code or share link) an encrypted room

exports.name: attach
exports.signature: attach(room, { mine, onPose, hz, channel, validate }) → { update(dt), dispose(), channel }
exports.does: the pose loop: update(dt) sends mine() every 1/hz seconds; onPose(data, userId) gets the others'

exports.name: approach
exports.does: eases toward a received value, the same at any framerate

exports.name: approachAngle
exports.does: the same for headings, the short way round

exports.name: every
exports.does: true once per 1/hz seconds of frame time: pace sends from the loop

exports.name: shareLink
exports.does: a link that reopens the game and joins the room (?room=)

exports.name: roomFrom
exports.does: the room code from a pasted code or share link

exports.name: q
exports.does: rounds a number for the wire

options.name: app
options.does: a stable id for your game, e.g. 'my-game.v1'

options.name: host
options.does: open a new room instead of joining one

options.name: code
options.does: the room code or share link to join

options.name: maxUsers
options.does: room size; every peer connects to every other

options.name: mine
options.does: your pose to send, e.g. [q(x), q(z), q(yaw), state]

hooks.name: onPose
hooks.does: attach: called with (data, userId) for each other peer's pose

title: P2P multiplayer: co-op with no server
description: Agent skill: add peer-to-peer co-op to a browser game. Pick the pattern by game speed (host-authoritative snapshots with p2p-homestead, or split ownership with p2p-room), write down who owns what, send small arrays at fixed rates from the frame loop, validate every peer message, ease what you receive, seed the static world instead of sending it, share links inside the warehouse player, and test with a fake transport and two real browsers. Says the limits: no host migration, no TURN, peer-owned state can be faked.
author: the internet slop warehouse
